name: Society C | Headband
description: Society C's Headband is a groovy hybrid strain, mixing OG Kush and Sour Diesel. It has a tasty creamy lemon-diesel flavor and features terpenes like myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene. Users usually feel euphoric, creative, and a bit cerebral when they smoke it.
